Legacy DT table functions

Source: R/dt.R
DT.Table.Rd

Older functions for DT tables, kept for existing code. For new code, use rvisPlot("table", "DT", ...) (see the tables guide).

Usage

DT.Table(x, links = NULL, session = NULL, options = list(), rownames = T)

DT.Table.Classify.bold(x, classColumn, boldValues = "TRUE")

Arguments

x

A data frame (DT.Table()) or a DT table (DT.Table.Classify.bold()).

links

Optional list of links added to the cells.

session

Shiny session, needed with links.

options

List of DataTables options, passed to DT::datatable().

rownames

Whether to show the row names.

classColumn

Name of the column deciding which rows are bold.

boldValues

Values of classColumn whose rows are bold.

Value

A DT table (htmlwidget).

Details

DT.Table() makes a DT table of x without escaping html. A list options$header gives CSS properties of the header row. links adds action links to cells (they need the shiny session). DT.Table.Classify.bold() makes the rows bold whose value in column classColumn is one of boldValues.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tbl <- DT.Table(head(mtcars), options = list(header = list(`background-color` = "#ddd")))
DT.Table.Classify.bold(DT.Table(data.frame(a = 1:3, big = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE))), "big")
} # }
